The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

To understand blockchain technology, imagine a community notebook used by a small village to record who owes whom money. In a traditional system, only one person (like a bank) holds the master notebook, and everyone must trust that person not to make mistakes or cheat. In a blockchain system, every single person in the village has an identical copy of this notebook. When a new transaction happens, everyone writes it down in their own copy. Before the entry is considered final, the villagers compare their notes. If the majority agree that the transaction is valid, it is permanently added to everyone’s book. Because everyone has a copy, no single person can secretly change the records without everyone else noticing, making the system incredibly secure and transparent.
